user.title: Add a zone
user.description: Learns how fast this zone heats up from its history and tells you how many minutes of heating it needs to reach the target.

data_description.zone_name: Name of the zone (room or heating zone); also used for the entity IDs.
data_description.climate_entity: Climate entity of the zone. Uses current_temperature, hvac_action, temperature (target) and the HVAC mode.
data_description.room_temperature_sensor: Optional. Replaces the thermostat's current_temperature (e.g. a sensor away from the radiator).
data_description.heating_effort_sensor: Optional. Heating demand in % (0-100), e.g. valve opening. Without it the effort comes from hvac_action (heating = 100 %, idle/off = 0 %).
data_description.heat_source_entity: Optional. Entity that is on while the boiler / heat pump really produces heat (e.g. a boiler 'heating active' binary sensor, or the burner power: > 0 = on). The thermostat often reports heating while the boiler is idle; with this set, heating counts only while the heat source is on.
data_description.outdoor_temperature_sensor: Optional. Current outdoor temperature (history is used for learning).
data_description.weather_entity: Optional. Forecast for the preheat window (hourly, else twice daily, else daily) and outdoor temperature when no outdoor sensor is set.
data_description.arrival_sensor: Optional. Timestamp sensor with the expected arrival (e.g. sensor.house_next_return_eta from Home Return Predictor): enables the preheat start and preheat now entities.
data_description.target_mode: Use a fixed target or follow the thermostat's set temperature.
data_description.target_temperature: Target used in fixed mode (also the fallback when the thermostat has no set temperature).
data_description.preheat_preset: With the preset target mode: preset whose temperature (preset_temperatures.PRESET_temp (PRESET = this preset)) is the preheat target, e.g. comfort. Falls back to the fixed target when the thermostat does not expose it.
data_description.target_entity: With the sensor target mode: numeric sensor or input_number (°C) whose value is the preheat target, e.g. a template giving the schedule's temperature at the expected arrival. Falls back to the fixed target while it is unavailable.

data_description.target_mode: Use a fixed target or follow the thermostat's set temperature.
data_description.target_temperature: Target used in fixed mode (also the fallback when the thermostat has no set temperature).
data_description.half_life_days: Older data weighs half after this many days (adapts to seasons).
data_description.history_days: Days of recorder history loaded on first start and by the retrain action.
data_description.update_interval_minutes: How often the estimate is recomputed, in minutes.
data_description.arrival_hold_minutes: With an arrival sensor: how long preheat now stays on after the expected arrival time when it was on and nobody has arrived yet (a static arrival time that has passed). 0 = off at the arrival time.
data_description.preheat_preset: With the preset target mode: preset whose temperature (preset_temperatures.PRESET_temp (PRESET = this preset)) is the preheat target, e.g. comfort. Falls back to the fixed target when the thermostat does not expose it.
data_description.max_sensor_age_minutes: The indoor temperature counts as missing when its sensor has not reported for this long (a dead or flat-battery sensor); the zone then reports no_temperature.
data_description.lead_quantile: How cautious the preheat start is: the start uses the heat-up time that real heat-ups of this zone met this often (0.8 = ready in time about 4 times out of 5; 0.5 = central estimate).
data_description.target_entity: With the sensor target mode: numeric sensor or input_number (°C) whose value is the preheat target, e.g. a template giving the schedule's temperature at the expected arrival. Falls back to the fixed target while it is unavailable.

options.climate_preset: Thermostat preset temperature (e.g. Versatile Thermostat comfort)

retrain.name: Retrain
retrain.description: Merge the recorder history into the stored data and refit the model of the selected zones (all zones without a target).

entity_id.name: Entities
entity_id.description: Any entity of the zone (its thermostat, an input sensor or one of its sensors). Leave empty for all zones.

config_entry_id.name: Zone
config_entry_id.description: Config entry of the zone. Leave empty for all zones.

replace.name: Replace
replace.description: Discard the stored data and rebuild the model from the recorder history only. Off (default): the recorder history is merged into the stored data (the recorder wins where it has data), so data older than the recorder retention is kept.

reset.name: Reset
reset.description: Forget everything learnt by the selected zones (all zones without a target).

setpoint_below_current.title: {zone}: the setpoint never asks for a preheat
setpoint_below_current.description: The zone {zone} follows the thermostat target and has an arrival sensor, but for 24 hours its setpoint has stayed below the room temperature (a setback such as eco or frost), so no preheat is ever computed. Set the target mode to "Thermostat preset temperature" (preset comfort) in the zone options: the preheat then aims at the comfort temperature while the thermostat holds the setback.
